# Data and Model Replication

## Cleaning Data & Separating into Forestry, Farm, NBS Dataframes

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(mvtnorm)

raw <- read_excel("decoded_data.xls")

# Standardized predictor names matching the Rmd formulas
model_vars <- c(
  "age_mid",
  "HHincome",
  "Yearsowned",
  "resideonland",
  "forestlo3",
  "hireassistance",
  "Forlandinvestment",
  "Plantoreplant5yr",
  "Neverappliedtoacostsharepr",
  "Mountain"
)

outcomes <- c(
  "PWSIFORWOMB",
  "PWSIfarmWOMB",
  "PWSINBSWOMB"
)

# Subset complete cases for individual models
forest_data <- raw |>
  filter(PWSIFORWOMB %in% c(0, 1)) |>
  select(participation = PWSIFORWOMB, all_of(model_vars)) |>
  drop_na()

farm_data <- raw |>
  filter(PWSIfarmWOMB %in% c(0, 1)) |>
  select(participation = PWSIfarmWOMB, all_of(model_vars)) |>
  drop_na()

nbs_data <- raw |>
  filter(PWSINBSWOMB %in% c(0, 1)) |>
  select(participation = PWSINBSWOMB, all_of(model_vars)) |>
  drop_na()
```

## Landowner Distribution Visualization

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_data <- raw %>%
  select(Region, forestlo3, farmlo3) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(forestlo3, farmlo3),
    names_to = "landowner_type",
    values_to = "is_landowner"
  ) %>%
  filter(is_landowner == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    Region = recode(
      Region,
      Mountain = "Mountains",
      NorthCoastal = "North Coastal Plain",
      SouthCoastal = "South Coastal Plain"
    ),
    landowner_type = recode(
      landowner_type,
      forestlo3 = "Forest Landowners",
      farmlo3 = "Farm Landowners"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(Region, landowner_type, name = "count")

ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = landowner_type, y = count, fill = landowner_type)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = count),
    color = "white",
    vjust = 1.8,
    size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Forest Landowners" = "#417F00",
      "Farm Landowners" = "#D35400"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of respondents") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )
```

## Comparison Table for Paper's Sample vs. Our Sample

```{r}
paper_n <- c(
  Forestry = 146,
  Farm = 155,
  NBS = 153
)

forest_complete <- nrow(forest_data)
farm_complete <- nrow(farm_data)
nbs_complete <- nrow(nbs_data)

comparison_table <- tibble(
  Model = c("Forestry", "Farm", "NBS"),
  Paper = c(paper_n["Forestry"], paper_n["Farm"], paper_n["NBS"]),
  Our_cases = c(forest_complete, farm_complete, nbs_complete),
  Difference = Paper - Our_cases
)

comparison_table |> kable()
```

Here we see that we are missing 11 individuals in our usable data compared to the actual study, because 11 participants in our data are missing reported income (`HHincome` of `0` or `NA`).

## Comparing Summary Statistics (Table 2 Replication)

```{r}
# Keep only the two landowner groups used in Table 2 (groupLO: 1 = Forest, 2 = Farm)
table2_data <- raw |>
  filter(groupLO %in% c(1, 2)) |>
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      groupLO == 1 ~ "Forest",
      groupLO == 2 ~ "Farm"
    )
  )

group_totals <- table2_data |>
  count(group, name = "total_n")

# Income breakdown

  filter(HHincome %in% 1:6) |>
```

## Joint Multivariate Logistic Model (from Rmd)

```{r}
# 1. Define Model Equations
forest_eq <- PWSIFORWOMB ~
  age_mid + HHincome + Yearsowned + resideonland +
  forestlo3 + hireassistance + Forlandinvestment +
  Plantoreplant5yr + Neverappliedtoacostsharepr + Mountain

farm_eq <- update(forest_eq, PWSIfarmWOMB ~ .)
nbs_eq  <- update(forest_eq, PWSINBSWOMB ~ .)

predictors <- all.vars(forest_eq)[-1]

# 2. Keep complete predictors and at least one outcome observed
predictors_ok <- rowSums(is.na(raw[, predictors, drop = FALSE])) == 0
has_outcome   <- rowSums(!is.na(raw[, outcomes, drop = FALSE])) > 0

model_data <- raw[
  predictors_ok & has_outcome,
  unique(c(predictors, outcomes)),
  drop = FALSE
]

Y <- as.matrix(model_data[, outcomes])

# 3. Standardize predictor design matrix
X_raw <- model.matrix(delete.response(terms(forest_eq)), data = model_data)

if (qr(X_raw)$rank < ncol(X_raw)) {
  stop("Predictor matrix is not full rank; check redundant predictors.")
}

centers <- colMeans(X_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE])
scales  <- apply(X_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE], 2, sd)

X <- X_raw
X[, -1] <- scale(X_raw[, -1, drop = FALSE], center = centers, scale = scales)
k <- ncol(X)

# 4. Construct Latent Gaussian Correlation Matrix
make_R <- function(a) {
  r12 <- tanh(a[1])
  r13 <- tanh(a[2])
  partial23 <- tanh(a[3])
  r23 <- r12 * r13 + partial23 * sqrt((1 - r12^2) * (1 - r13^2))
  matrix(
    c(
      1,   r12, r13,
      r12, 1,   r23,
      r13, r23, 1
    ),
    nrow = 3,
    byrow = TRUE
  )
}

# 5. Negative Log-Likelihood Function
neg_loglik <- function(parameters) {
  B <- matrix(parameters[seq_len(3 * k)], nrow = k)
  R <- make_R(parameters[3 * k + seq_len(3)])
  probabilities <- plogis(X %*% B)
  probabilities <- pmin(pmax(probabilities, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)

  log_likelihood <- numeric(nrow(Y))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(Y))) {
    observed <- which(!is.na(Y[i, ]))
    y <- Y[i, observed]
    p <- probabilities[i, observed]

    if (length(observed) == 1) {
      log_likelihood[i] <- dbinom(y, size = 1, prob = p, log = TRUE)
    } else {
      signs <- ifelse(y == 1, 1, -1)
      upper <- signs * qnorm(p)
      R_observed <- R[observed, observed, drop = FALSE]
      R_signed <- R_observed * outer(signs, signs)

      joint_probability <- as.numeric(
        pmvnorm(
          lower = rep(-Inf, length(observed)),
          upper = upper,
          corr = R_signed,
          algorithm = TVPACK()
        )
      )

      if (!is.finite(joint_probability) || joint_probability <= 0) {
        return(1e100)
      }
      log_likelihood[i] <- log(joint_probability)
    }
  }
  -sum(log_likelihood)
}

# 6. Starting parameters
B_start <- sapply(seq_len(3), function(j) {
  observed <- !is.na(Y[, j])
  initial_fit <- glm.fit(
    x = X[observed, , drop = FALSE],
    y = Y[observed, j],
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
  initial_fit$coefficients
})

start <- c(as.vector(B_start), 0, 0, 0)

# 7. Joint Optimization
joint_fit <- optim(
  par = start,
  fn = neg_loglik,
  method = "L-BFGS-B",
  lower = c(rep(-Inf, 3 * k), rep(-3, 3)),
  upper = c(rep( Inf, 3 * k), rep( 3, 3)),
  hessian = TRUE,
  control = list(maxit = 1000)
)

# 8. Transform Coefficients and Unscale
B_scaled <- matrix(joint_fit$par[seq_len(3 * k)], nrow = k)
B_original <- B_scaled
B_original[-1, ] <- sweep(B_scaled[-1, , drop = FALSE], 1, scales, "/")
B_original[1, ]  <- B_scaled[1, ] - colSums(sweep(B_original[-1, , drop = FALSE], 1, centers, "*"))

rownames(B_original) <- colnames(X_raw)
colnames(B_original) <- c("Forestry", "Farm", "NBS")

# Compute standard errors on the unscaled scale using the Hessian
cov_scaled <- tryCatch(
  solve(joint_fit$hessian)[seq_len(3 * k), seq_len(3 * k)],
  error = function(e) matrix(NA, 3 * k, 3 * k)
)

# Scaling matrix for standard errors
S_inv_col <- c(1, 1 / scales)
scale_matrix <- diag(rep(S_inv_col, 3))
cov_unscaled <- scale_matrix %*% cov_scaled %*% scale_matrix
se_unscaled  <- matrix(sqrt(pmax(diag(cov_unscaled), 0)), nrow = k)
rownames(se_unscaled) <- colnames(X_raw)
colnames(se_unscaled) <- c("Forestry", "Farm", "NBS")

# Print the reproduced Odds Ratios 
round(exp(B_original), 3)
```

## Extracted Joint Model Results Table

```{r}
# Map coefficients, SEs, and ORs to tidy dataframe
replicated_models <- list()
model_names <- c("Forestry", "Farm", "NBS")

var_mapping <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
  "age_mid" = "Age",
  "HHincome" = "Income",
  "Yearsowned" = "Years owned",
  "resideonland" = "Reside on land",
  "forestlo3" = "Forest landowner",
  "hireassistance" = "Hire assistance",
  "Forlandinvestment" = "Land for investment",
  "Plantoreplant5yr" = "Plant or replant",
  "Neverappliedtoacostsharepr" = "Never applied cost-share",
  "Mountain" = "Mountain"
)

for (m in model_names) {
  b <- B_original[, m]
  se <- se_unscaled[, m]
  or <- exp(b)
  # Delta-method robust SE for odds-ratio scale: OR * SE(beta)
  or_se <- or * se
  z_val <- b / se
  p_val <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_val)))
  
  replicated_models[[m]] <- tibble(
    Model = m,
    Variable = var_mapping[names(b)],
    Our_OR = or,
    Our_Robust_SE = or_se,
    Our_p_value = p_val
  )
}

our_results <- bind_rows(replicated_models) |>
  mutate(across(c(Our_OR, Our_Robust_SE, Our_p_value), \(x) round(x, 3)))

our_results |> 
  rename(
    Rep_OR = Our_OR,
    Rep_Robust_SE = Our_Robust_SE,
    Rep_p_value = Our_p_value
  ) |> 
  kable(caption = "Joint Model Replicated Results")
```

## Model Comparison Tables (Replication vs. Actual)

```{r}
variable_order <- c(
  "Age",
  "Income",
  "Years owned",
  "Reside on land",
  "Forest landowner",
  "Hire assistance",
  "Land for investment",
  "Plant or replant",
  "Never applied cost-share",
  "Mountain",
  "Constant"
)

table4_comparison <- paper_results |>
  left_join(our_results, by = c("Model", "Variable")) |>
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = variable_order),
    `Actual OR (Robust SE)` = paste0(
      round(Paper_OR, 3),
      " (",
      round(Paper_Robust_SE, 3),
      ")"
    ),
    `Replicated OR (Robust SE)` = paste0(
      round(Our_OR, 3),
      " (",
      round(Our_Robust_SE, 3),
      ")"
    ),
    `Replicated p-value` = case_when(
      Our_p_value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001",
      TRUE ~ as.character(round(Our_p_value, 3))
    ),
    `Difference in OR` = round(Our_OR - Paper_OR, 3),
    absolute_difference = abs(Our_OR - Paper_OR)
  ) |>
  arrange(Model, Variable)

make_model_table <- function(model_name, paper_n, replicated_n) {
  one_model <- table4_comparison |>
    filter(Model == model_name) |>
    select(
      Variable,
      `Actual OR (Robust SE)`,
      `Actual p-value` = Paper_p_value,
      `Replicated OR (Robust SE)`,
      `Replicated p-value`,
      `Difference in OR`,
      absolute_difference
    )

  largest_difference_rows <- one_model |>
    filter(Variable != "Constant") |>
    slice_max(absolute_difference, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    pull(Variable)

  highlighted_row_numbers <- which(
    one_model$Variable %in% largest_difference_rows
  )

  one_model |>
    select(-absolute_difference) |>
    kable(
      format = "html",
      caption = paste0(
        model_name,
        " Participation Model ",
        "(Paper N = ", paper_n,
        "; Replicated N = ", replicated_n,
        ")"
      ),
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
      escape = FALSE
    ) |>
    kable_styling(
      full_width = FALSE,
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed")
    ) |>
    row_spec(
      highlighted_row_numbers,
      background = "#FFF3CD",
      bold = TRUE
    )
}

# Table 1: Forestry model
make_model_table(
  model_name = "Forestry",
  paper_n = 146,
  replicated_n = nrow(forest_data)
)

# Table 2: Farm model
make_model_table(
  model_name = "Farm",
  paper_n = 155,
  replicated_n = nrow(farm_data)
)

# Table 3: Nature-based-solutions model
make_model_table(
  model_name = "NBS",
  paper_n = 153,
  replicated_n = nrow(nbs_data)
)
```
